cards.ex: With interest rates so low, it's definitely a homeowner's market right now.
cards.exUz: Foiz stavkalari juda past bo'lgani uchun, hozir uy egalari bozori.
cards.uzDef: Uylar sotuvchilarga foydali bo'lgan bozor holati, talab yuqori va taklif kam.

cards.ex: The subway car was packed like sardines during rush hour.
cards.exUz: Metro vagoni gavjum paytida seldadek tiqilib ketgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda tiqilib ketgan, odamlar bir-biriga yaqin joylashgan.

cards.ex: Once you move to the city, you have to fend for yourself; no one will hold your hand.
cards.exUz: Shaharga ko'chib o'tgandan so'ng, o'zing uchun kurashishing kerak; hech kim senga yordam bermaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'z ehtiyojlaringizni o'zingiz qondirishga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: Sometimes I miss the countryside, living in a concrete jungle like this can be draining.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan qishloqni sog'inaman, bunday beton o'rmonda yashash charchatadi.
cards.uzDef: Tabiat kam bo'lgan, beton binolar ko'p bo'lgan shahar.

cards.ex: They renovated the apartment on a shoestring budget, mostly using recycled materials.
cards.exUz: Ular kvartirani juda kam pulga, asosan qayta ishlangan materiallardan foydalanib ta'mirlashdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kam pul bilan yashash.

cards.ex: He decided to leave the rat race and move to a small farm in the country.
cards.exUz: U kalamush poygasini tashlab, qishloqdagi kichik fermaga ko'chib o'tishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Muqobatsiz ish hayoti, faqat pul topish uchun.

cards.ex: We moved further out of the city to get some breathing room and a bigger yard.
cards.exUz: Biz nafas olish joyi va kattaroq hovli olish uchun shahardan uzoqroqqa ko'chib o'tdik.
cards.uzDef: Qulay yashash uchun yetarli joy yoki imkoniyat.

cards.ex: They were struggling financially, but they tried to keep up appearances by buying a new car.
cards.exUz: Ular moliyaviy qiyinchiliklarga duch kelishdi, lekin yangi mashina sotib olib ko'rinishni saqlashga harakat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Boy yoki baxtli ko'rinishga harakat qilish, aslida unday bo'lmasa ham.

cards.ex: Many artists are looking for affordable live-work spaces in the city.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina rassomlar shaharda arzon ish-turar joylarni qidirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Uy va ish joyi bir joyda birlashtirilgan maydon.

cards.ex: The brownstone buildings in Brooklyn are known for their classic architecture.
cards.exUz: Bruklyndagi jigarrang tosh binolar o'zlarining klassik arxitekturasi bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Jigarrang qumtosh bilan qoplangan shahar uyi.

cards.ex: After moving so many times, they finally decided to put down roots in this town.
cards.exUz: Ko'p marta ko'chib o'tgandan so'ng, ular nihoyat shu shaharda ildiz otishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Bir joyda uzoq vaqt yashashni rejalashtirish, o'z joyini topish.

cards.ex: The city provides social housing for low-income families.
cards.exUz: Shahar kam daromadli oilalar uchun ijtimoiy uy-joy bilan ta'minlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Hukumat tomonidan ta'minlangan arzon uy-joy.

cards.ex: The commuter belt has expanded as more people seek affordable housing outside the city.
cards.exUz: Shahardan tashqarida arzon uy-joy qidirayotgan odamlar ko'paygani sayin, qatma-qat hudud kengaydi.
cards.uzDef: Shahardan uzoqroq, lekin ishga qatnaydiganlar uchun qulay joylar.

cards.ex: The neighborhood watch group acts as the eyes and ears of the community.
cards.exUz: Mahalla kuzatuv guruhi jamiyatning ko'zi va qulog'i vazifasini bajaradi.
cards.uzDef: Atrofdagi hamma narsani kuzatib turadigan odamlar.

cards.ex: All the apartment needs is a fresh coat of paint to make it look brand new.
cards.exUz: Kvartiraga yangi bo'yoq qatlami kerak, shunda u yangi ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Bo'yoqning yangi qatlami, yangi ko'rinish beradi.

cards.ex: The community garden is a true urban oasis in the middle of the busy city.
cards.exUz: Jamiyat bog'i gavjum shahar o'rtasida haqiqiy shahar vohasidir.
cards.uzDef: Shaharda tabiat bilan ajratilgan tinch joy.

cards.ex: Growing up in the city gave him a lot of street smarts.
cards.exUz: Shaharda o'sganligi unga ko'cha aqlliligini berdi.
cards.uzDef: Shaharda xavfsiz bo'lish uchun zarur bo'lgan bilim va instinkt.

cards.ex: The high street is usually very busy on Saturdays.
cards.exUz: Markaziy ko'cha odatda shanba kunlari juda gavjum bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Do'konlar va bizneslar joylashgan asosiy ko'cha.

cards.ex: Moving to a new city is sink or swim; you have to adapt quickly.
cards.exUz: Yangi shaharga ko'chish - bu cho'k yoki suz; tezda moslashishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatda muvaffaqiyatga erishish yoki mag'lub bo'lish.

cards.ex: I'm tired of the daily grind of commuting and working long hours.
cards.exUz: Men kundalik mashaqqatdan, ishga qatnash va uzoq soatlar ishlashdan charchadim.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik ish, zerikarli va qiyin.

cards.ex: The neighborhood went through a bad phase, but hopefully, it'll run its course soon.
cards.exUz: Mahalla yomon davrdan o'tdi, lekin umid qilamanki, u tez orada o'z yo'lini o'taydi.
cards.uzDef: Nimanidir tugatish yoki o'z oxiriga yetkazish.

cards.ex: The city has several new housing projects in the pipeline.
cards.exUz: Shaharda kelajakda amalga oshirilishi rejalashtirilgan bir nechta yangi uy-joy loyihalari mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda amalga oshirilishi rejalashtirilgan.

cards.ex: This small cafe is my home away from home; I come here every day.
cards.exUz: Bu kichik kafe mening uydan uzoqdagi uyim; men bu yerga har kuni kelaman.
cards.uzDef: Uydagidek qulay bo'lgan joy.

cards.ex: Having a supermarket on the doorstep is so convenient.
cards.exUz: Eshik oldida supermarketning bo'lishi juda qulay.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin joyda.

cards.ex: Living in this concrete jungle can be stressful, but it's also exciting.
cards.exUz: Bu beton o'rmonda yashash stressli bo'lishi mumkin, lekin u ham hayajonli.
cards.uzDef: Tabiat kam bo'lgan, beton binolar ko'p bo'lgan shahar.

cards.ex: We need to move to a bigger apartment to give the kids some breathing space.
cards.exUz: Bolalarga nafas olish joyi berish uchun biz kattaroq kvartiraga ko'chishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Stresssiz va qulay bo'lish uchun yetarli vaqt va joy.

cards.ex: The noise from the construction site is starting to get out of hand.
cards.exUz: Qurilish maydonchasidan kelayotgan shovqin nazoratdan chiqa boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat nazoratdan chiqib ketishi.

cards.ex: The landlord will foot the bill for the plumbing repairs.
cards.exUz: Uy egasi santexnika ta'mirining to'lovini to'laydi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir to'lovni to'lashga javobgar bo'lish.

cards.ex: We spent the afternoon window shopping on the high street.
cards.exUz: Biz tushdan keyin markaziy ko'chada derazadan tomosha qilib vaqt o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Pul sarflamasdan, do'konlarni tomosha qilish.

cards.ex: The deal fell through, so we're back to square one in our search for a new apartment.
cards.exUz: Kelishuv bekor bo'ldi, shuning uchun biz yangi kvartira qidiruvida boshidan boshlayapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi holatga qaytish, yangidan boshlash.
